content:
Following a preview at the May I/O 2026 conference, the macOS version of Gemini is now rolling out advanced voice control features.

Google positions this feature as allowing you to "speak in natural language in any window on your desktop," comprising two main capabilities.

First is the Smart Dictation feature, which can "transcribe spoken content into clean, polished text." Gemini will automatically remove filler words like "um" and "ah," while recognizing mid-sentence corrections to capture the key point you want to express.

The formatted text will be input at your current cursor position. This will provide a voice-to-text experience similar to the upcoming Gboard Rambler for Gemini Intelligence on mobile.

The other feature goes beyond mere transcription, capable of understanding the content on your current screen to execute complex tasks. This opt-in feature requires you to enable Gemini reasoning in the app's settings.

  • Extract and summarize information: select local files, images, or documents on your desktop, then tell Gemini directly what you need. For example, you can say: "Look at these veterinary documents, summarize my dog's medical history, and send an email to the boarding hotel."
  • Write and rewrite text: select text anywhere on screen, use your voice to instantly rewrite or adjust the tone, then place the polished version exactly where you need it. Try saying something like: "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary, with a TL;DR at the top."
  • Generate and edit images: use your voice to create visual content, whether brainstorming concepts, enriching an itinerary, or making quick modifications based on a design on your desk. Try saying something like: "Generate a dark mode version of this illustration."

Launch by long-pressing the Fn key anywhere in macOS, or by clicking the new screen-sharing button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" dialog box. Gemini will display a floating capsule with a soundwave pattern at the bottom of the screen.

Please ensure you have updated to the latest version of Gemini for macOS (1.88). This new voice feature is rolling out globally to all users, currently supporting English, with more languages "coming soon."
